verdictRule: CONSENT only if mustFixCount == 0 and shouldFixCount == 0
summary: CONSENT at zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. The D-271 draft remains at the dispatched digest and mode 0444; all twelve file-backed measured inputs and HEAD reproduce. Both Stage A reviews are independent ACCEPT 0/0 on the same frozen g22-leftover-join.v5 candidate. Claude's four observationsNotFindings remain unlabeled strings with no advisories field and request no change, while Codex supplies an empty observationsNotFindings list, zero advisories, and no observations; the draft invents no identifier and claims no bilateral identifier preservation. G22 v4 remains current at draft time and becomes historical only after successor recording; v3 is historical; occupancy v2 and platform-tcb v9 retain their respective current standings. leftoverDesign remains [OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING], with OBL-RESERVED-TABLES left on DR-126. The no-cell-edit branch excludes D-236, readiness arithmetic remains unchanged, and the draft creates no SATISFIED, fixture, table, Rosetta, occupancy, file-08, premature COORD, or implementation authority.
